collection.title: SEAT Mii 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Mii Hatchback 2011 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Mii which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: SEAT Mii 2011 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
